log.title: Sworn in as President
log.body: Golden Fixture takes the oath of office. Review the budget and your departments: the nation is watching your first decisions.

log.title: Embassy opened in United States
log.body: A permanent mission now works in United States (₹15 crore a month). Relations improve and proposals are likelier to succeed.

log.title: Upgrading Primary care
log.body: ₹4,500 crore goes into the Health department's primary care. It gains a star in about a month.

log.title: Construction begins in the East
log.body: Work starts on 500 × primary school for ₹500 crore. They open in a few weeks.

log.title: Police recruited in the North
log.body: 5,000 officers join the force for ₹100 crore in training. Their pay comes out of the Home Affairs budget.

log.title: Intelligence service: strength 55
log.body: The intelligence service grows from 50 to 55 for ₹600 crore; its running costs rise with it.

log.title: Power project begins in the West
log.body: Work starts on 4 × solar park for ₹6,000 crore, adding 0.4 GW on average. It connects to the grid in a few weeks.

log.title: Licence granted in the South
log.body: An investor pays ₹180 crore for a licence to build a textile mill. It should open in about 2 months and pay corporate tax on its profits.

log.title: Trade rules for electronics
log.body: New rules for electronics: tariff 20%, no import quota, no ban.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade
log.body: The service chiefs suggest a large parade to show the forces to the public and raise morale.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions
log.body: Intermediaries suggest that a quiet round of talks with the most hostile neighbour might lower the temperature.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border
log.body: Gold, arms and drugs are flowing across a porous stretch of the frontier, with local officials turning a blind eye.

log.title: Death in police custody
log.body: A man died in a police lock-up. Protests have begun and videos are circulating widely.

log.title: India is asked to host a world trade expo
log.body: The organisers of a major trade expo want India as host. Delegations from dozens of countries would visit, with the contracts and publicity that follow.

log.title: Opened in the East
log.body: 500 × primary school open to the public.

log.title: Connected to the grid in the West
log.body: 4 × solar park now generate 0.4 GW on average.

log.title: Primary care: 3 stars
log.body: The Health department's primary care is now rated 3 of 5.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The parade is shelved and units keep to their training schedule.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You keep your distance. The opposition asks what you are afraid of.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Smuggling continues, and so does the bribery that enables it.

log.title: Death in police custody: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You defend the police. Protests grow.

log.title: Private plant opens in the South
log.body: 1 × textile mill start production.

log.title: India is asked to host a world trade expo: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Another country takes the expo.

log.title: Police modernisation plan
log.body: The Home ministry proposes a plan to upgrade police radios, forensics and patrol vehicles nationwide.

log.title: Intelligence foils a plot by The Crimson Hand
log.body: Agents uncovered The Crimson Hand preparing an attack in the East. The cell was rolled up before it could act.

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: Press freedom row
log.body: Editors are protesting over a law that would let officials block critical reports. Where do you stand?

log.title: Police modernisation plan: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You defer the plan.

log.title: Refugees arrive at the border
log.body: Thousands of people fleeing violence in a neighbouring country are gathering at the border and asking for shelter.

log.title: Germany proposes a trade contract
log.body: Germany offers a 3-year industry contract worth ₹1,35,800 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Chance to address the nation
log.body: Broadcasters offer prime time for a national address. What will you talk about?

log.title: New disease spreads across borders
log.body: A fast-moving respiratory illness has reached several continents. Airlines are cancelling routes and the first cases have been reported in India.

log.title: Press freedom row: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You say nothing. The row fades.

log.title: Refugees arrive at the border: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The border is closed. Harsh pictures circulate abroad.

log.title: New disease spreads across borders: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The government urges caution and little else. Hospitals fill up and voters notice.

log.title: Displaced people arrive from Nepal
log.body: Fighting and hardship in Nepal are pushing thousands across the border. Local officials say shelters are filling and ask for guidance.

log.title: Chance to address the nation: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline and the slot goes to the opposition.

log.title: Unidentified drones over a base
log.body: Unidentified drones have been spotted over a military base near the border. Radar picked them up too late.

log.title: Climate summit: Germany presses for commitments
log.body: Leaders are gathering to agree new targets for cutting emissions. Germany is lobbying hard for developing economies to take on binding goals.

log.title: Displaced people arrive from Nepal: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Border posts are reinforced. Neighbours criticise the decision.

log.title: Anti-corruption bill
log.body: A cross-party group offers a bill to give the anti-corruption agency stronger powers and tougher penalties.

log.title: Security gap at major airports
log.body: A surprise audit shows that screening at several airports and rail hubs can be bypassed.

log.title: Goodwill from Philippines
log.body: Philippines praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Climate summit: Germany presses for commitments: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. India agrees to targets tied to finance and technology from richer countries.

log.title: Start-up boom
log.body: A wave of young companies is raising funds and hiring. Cities are buzzing.

log.title: Gaffe in a live interview
log.body: An off-the-cuff remark in a live interview has gone viral for the wrong reasons.

log.title: Anti-corruption bill: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You shelve the bill. Campaigners are disappointed.

log.title: Security gap at major airports: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The upgrade is added to a long list of plans.

log.title: Friction with Colombia
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Colombia. Relations cool a little.

log.title: A supplier offers equipment at a discount
log.body: A friendly industrial power offers a batch of modern equipment on favourable terms, if you act this quarter.

log.title: City flooding in the North
log.body: Record rain has swamped streets, power lines and underpasses in the North. Commuters are stranded and shops are shut.

log.title: Land acquisition protests in the West
log.body: Villagers in the West are blocking surveyors from a planned industrial corridor, saying compensation is far too low.

log.title: Youth town hall
log.body: Student groups invite you to a televised town hall on jobs, climate and the future.

log.title: Vote at the UN: Brazil seeks India’s support
log.body: Brazil has asked India to back its draft resolution at the General Assembly. Other delegations are lobbying the other way.

log.title: City flooding in the North: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The central government stays out. Anger builds in the North.

log.title: A supplier offers equipment at a discount: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The offer lapses. Domestic manufacturers are pleased.

log.title: Intelligence warning: The Ember Front plotting an attack in the North-East
log.body: Intelligence has picked up chatter that The Ember Front is preparing a strike in the North-East. There is a window of a few weeks to act.

log.title: Intelligence warning: The Ember Front plotting an attack in the North-East: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You raise the alert level and wait.

log.title: Vote at the UN: Brazil seeks India’s support: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. India abstains. No one is offended and no one is grateful.

log.title: Earthquake in the North
log.body: A strong earthquake has shaken the North. Buildings have collapsed and rescue teams are digging through rubble.

log.title: Land acquisition protests in the West: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Work proceeds under heavy police guard. Resentment burns.

log.title: Youth town hall: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The envoy does a competent job. Few notice.

log.title: Aircraft stray into Indian airspace
log.body: Tirhani aircraft crossed the western frontier for several minutes before turning back. Fighters were scrambled.

log.title: Relief supplies diverted in the North
log.body: Reports say relief grain and blankets meant for the North were sold in the open market. Survivors are furious.

log.title: Saudi Arabia invites the President to a summit
log.body: Saudi Arabia has invited the President to a bilateral summit on trade and security. A visit would be a chance to deepen the relationship.

log.title: Earthquake in the North: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The central government stays out. Anger builds in the North.

log.title: Invitation for a state visit
log.body: A friendly government invites you for a state visit and a round of trade talks.

log.title: Police reform demanded
log.body: After a controversial arrest, civil-rights groups demand sweeping police reform: body cameras, training and oversight.

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: United States proposes a trade contract
log.body: United States offers a 3-year tech contract worth ₹1,41,100 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Relief supplies diverted in the North: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The denials ring hollow and the story grows.

log.title: Procurement scam exposed
log.body: A leaked audit shows inflated prices on a large defence-supply and infrastructure contract. Bidders cry foul.

log.title: Aircraft stray into Indian airspace: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Tirhan calls it a navigation error. The note is filed.

log.title: Attack in the North-East
log.body: The Ember Front carried out an attack in the North-East. Emergency services responded; the nation mourns and demands answers.

log.title: Saudi Arabia invites the President to a summit: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The foreign secretary attends in the President’s place. The host is satisfied.

log.title: The nation responds to the attack in the North-East
log.body: Funerals and vigils continue in the North-East. The public is looking to you for answers.

log.title: Invitation for a state visit: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline and stay home.

log.title: Police reform demanded: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You reject the demand. The criticism gets louder.

log.title: France proposes a trade contract
log.body: France offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,42,000 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Japan proposes a trade contract
log.body: Japan offers a 3-year tech contract worth ₹1,42,000 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: The nation responds to the attack in the North-East: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You leave it to the agencies. The public notices the silence.

log.title: Procurement scam exposed: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The contract stands. Whispers of a cover-up follow you.

log.title: Global recession
log.body: Major economies are contracting together. Export orders are drying up and capital is leaving emerging markets.

log.title: Global recession: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The budget stays disciplined while exports fall. Unemployment drifts up.

log.title: Goodwill from Taiwan
log.body: Taiwan praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border
log.body: Gold, arms and drugs are flowing across a porous stretch of the frontier, with local officials turning a blind eye.

log.title: Private plants close
log.body: A poor business climate drives owners to close 1 × electronics plant (South).

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: South Africa proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: South Africa proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Explosives cache found
log.body: A tip-off led police to a hidden store of explosives and detonators before they could be used.

log.title: Trade dispute with Myanmar
log.body: Myanmar has raised duties on Indian goods, saying India’s own tariffs are unfair. Exporters want the government to act.

log.title: Questions over a defence contract
log.body: A newspaper alleges inflated prices and favoured suppliers in a recent equipment contract. The opposition wants an inquiry.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Smuggling continues, and so does the bribery that enables it.

log.title: United Kingdom proposes a trade contract
log.body: United Kingdom offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,44,700 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Trade dispute with Myanmar: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Exporters absorb the higher duties for months.

log.title: Annual report 2026
log.body: The government closed 2026 with a deficit of ₹8,00,040 crore. Growth 4.5%, inflation 3.7%, unemployment 8.1%, debt 53.3% of GDP. Approval stands at 21.7%.

log.title: Tax evasion exposé
log.body: Investigative reporters reveal that large firms and wealthy families have been hiding income abroad. The Finance ministry is under fire.

log.title: Questions over a defence contract: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The ministry insists the contract was sound. The press keeps digging.

log.title: Export boom
log.body: Overseas demand for manufactured goods and services is surging. Order books are full and customs receipts are up.

log.title: Disinformation campaign
log.body: A flood of fake videos and forwarded messages is stoking panic and distrust online.

log.title: Australia proposes a trade contract
log.body: Australia offers a 3-year agriculture contract worth ₹1,45,800 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Goodwill from Peru
log.body: Peru praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.
